changelog: [When to Segment]: broadened the existing '?'-boundary rule to also permit segmenting after a complete question when followed by a trailing noun-phrase/list elaboration (not just a purpose/reason clause), recovering free latency gains the critic measured on question+list sentences without adding a new rule category.

[When to Segment]: broadened the existing sentence-initial discourse-marker/filler+connective rule to explicitly cover chains of two or more repeated discourse markers/fillers before the first substantive independent clause, since these chains are still a free, low-risk boundary and were being left unsplit.

[Examples — Segment]: added two new illustrative example pairs (question + trailing list, filler-chain + substantive clause) demonstrating the broadened rules; kept the section under the 12-example cap without removing existing examples.
